minor.issue: ProfileIn.model_dump() sends every unset field as null. A partial POST (e.g. only {reminder_enabled, reminder_day}) wipes existing age/gender/hair_type/goals to null. Should use exclude_unset=True or $set only provided keys.

Manual analyze does NOT persist the current session's `region` on the analysis doc. If a user first runs /scan with region=crown and later runs manual analyze on the same day session, the region field on analysis becomes undefined and the Results page's region-badge disappears. /scan's finalize_day_analysis writes region; /analyze should read session.region (or preserve prior analysis.region) for consistency.

Files that fail image_utils.process_image are silently skipped. If ALL frames fail (e.g. non-image bytes), a 400 'No valid frames captured' is correctly returned, but partial failures are invisible to the client. Consider including frames_rejected count in the response.

integration_issues.issue: Manual /analyze overwrites the previous /scan analysis and drops the region field; Results.jsx then hides the region-badge because a.region is undefined. Backend bug (see backend_issues.minor).

action_items: Backend: In upsert_profile, use body.model_dump(exclude_unset=True) so partial updates (e.g. only reminder toggle) don't wipe age/gender/hair_type/goals.

Backend: analyze_session should include region on the analysis doc (pulled from tracking_sessions.region or existing analysis.region) so Results.jsx region-badge continues to render after a manual re-analyze.
(Optional) Nice-to-have: return frames_rejected count in /api/scan response so the UI can show 'analyzed X of Y frames captured'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /profile: `doc = body.model_dump()` overwrites all fields, including with None. Partial updates lose data — bug.
server.py analyze_session (line ~442): builds new analysis doc but never carries region forward. Inconsistent with /scan's finalize_day_analysis which does set region.

server.py get_or_create_today_session: computes week_number = count of existing sessions. Fine, but note this is 'session index', not calendar week; the field naming is a small mismatch — consider renaming to `session_index` for clarity.

ai_service.py exception paths still return neutral hardcoded scores (65/68/70/75, quality=72). A silent AI-provider outage would still yield 'analysis' — masks real failures. Consider raising or flagging fallback=true.
storage.py init_storage() mutates module-level storage_key without a lock — fine for single-worker uvicorn, would race under multi-worker.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for what could be tested (auto-scan UI only, side-by-side, region-badge, report/download, settings reminder, dashboard banner). Real 30s camera capture cannot be exercised in headless browser — verified UI only per task note.
